integrity: Standalone arithmetic checker supplied; exhaustive finite tests corroborate but do not certify the infinite theorem. All geometric assertions are proved from stated algebraic arguments.
scientific_limitations: Reduced commuting variety of rank-at-most-one nilpotent matrix tuples, n>=4; does not determine nonreduced scheme structure, higher-rank nilpotents, conjugacy quotients, or independent literature priority. Dimension-three minimal-orbit case has an acknowledged prior classification.
title: A sharp irreducibility transition for commuting minimal-nilpotent matrix tuples
